instruction_ref: CEO 2026-11-27: 商品紹介はシンプルになったけど、一文すぎるかも。強制をしないが目安は与えて欲しい。
instruction: Provide a soft editorial writing guide for product cassette descriptions: normally two to three natural sentences, approximately 60–120 Japanese characters; allow one sentence when sufficient. Do not introduce a length/sentence-count quality gate or force facts, product appeals, or specifications. Preserve existing affiliate SEO/AEO strategy, independent QA and safety/product fidelity checks.
preserved_rules: No hard length or sentence-count QA gate
No change to product selection or six-product grouping
No mandatory appeals, personas or optional specifications
No changes to safety, identity, SEO/AEO, Claim QA, publication or approval gates
No Codex code edits or runtime routing changes
